sections.title: Applicant Information
sections.description: Basic details about the child applicant's current age and marital status.

questions.label: What is the applicant's current age?
questions.helpText: Age determines IR-2 eligibility; the child must be under 21 and unmarried.

questions.label: Is the applicant currently studying or attending school?
questions.helpText: Whether the applicant is currently enrolled in school or another study program.

questions.label: Does the applicant have any brothers or sisters?
questions.helpText: Includes full, half, step, and adopted siblings.

sections.title: Petitioner Information
sections.description: Identifies who is filing, or has filed, the immigrant petition for the applicant.

questions.label: Who is filing or has filed the petition for the applicant?
questions.helpText: This is the U.S. citizen or permanent resident sponsoring the child.

sections.title: Parent-Child Relationship
sections.description: Establishes the qualifying parent-child relationship between the applicant and the petitioner.

questions.label: What is the applicant's relationship with the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Select the legal relationship that forms the basis of the petition.

questions.label: If the petitioner is the applicant's biological parent, who is the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Only relevant when the relationship is biological.

questions.label: If the petitioner is the applicant's biological father, were the applicant's biological parents married when the applicant was born?
questions.helpText: Marriage at the time of birth can affect whether the child qualifies as a 'child' under immigration law.

questions.label: If the petitioner is the applicant's stepparent, did the marriage between the stepparent and the applicant's biological parent take place before the applicant turned 18?
questions.helpText: The step-relationship must have been created before the applicant's 18th birthday.

questions.label: If the applicant is adopted, which statement best describes the adoption case?
questions.helpText: Different adoption routes (general, sibling exception, Hague/orphan) have different eligibility rules.
options: Adopted Under the Sibling Exception Before Age 18

sections.title: Living Arrangements & Relationship
sections.description: The applicant's current living situation and contact with the petitioner.

questions.label: Who does the applicant currently live with?
questions.helpText: Helps assess custody, consent, and the child's current care arrangement.

questions.label: How frequently does the applicant communicate with the petitioner?
questions.helpText: Ongoing contact supports the genuineness of the parent-child relationship.

sections.title: Travel & Immigration Background
sections.description: Prior U.S. travel, visa refusals, and immigration violations relevant to the interview.

questions.label: Has the applicant ever travelled to the United States?
options: Yes, previously lived in the U.S.

questions.label: Has the applicant ever been refused a U.S. visa?
What type of U.S. visa was refused?
questions.helpText: Only asked when a previous U.S. visa refusal is reported.

questions.label: Has the applicant ever overstayed a visa, violated immigration conditions, or been involved in a U.S. immigration violation?
Has the applicant ever been deported, removed, or formally ordered to leave the United States?
